relations: The rightmost upright pink box tilts first, falling flat as its left neighbor leans in sequence.
The toppling cascade moves leftward box by box until all five rest flat with DOMINO faces up.
After the boxes settle, the embedded run of white dominoes inside the wavy cookie line tips over.
The top row, central logo, surrounding white dominoes, and bottom straight line remain unchanged throughout.
caption: The video showcases a wide overhead arrangement of domino boxes and cookies on a light wood floor. Across the top stands a long row of upright pink-and-green boxes, while a central graphic spells DOMINO in black tiles over a pink oval ringed by white dominoes. Below, a wavy line of dark cookies holds an embedded run of white dominoes, and five upright pink boxes wait on their ends. A right-to-left toppling cascade moves through the five pink boxes. The rightmost box tilts first, lying flat as its neighbor leans, and the sequence continues leftward box by box until all five rest flat with their DOMINO faces up. The top row, the central logo and its surrounding white dominoes, and the bottom straight cookie-and-domino line stay unchanged, while motion blur marks each box only during its individual fall. After the boxes settle, the small embedded run of white dominoes inside the wavy line tips over. The rest of the display remains standing, captured by a stationary camera.
